name: com.4fillment/fulfillment
title: 4fillment
description: US 3PL warehouse: services, rate card, fee estimates, product checks and a hand-off to a person.

tools.name: get_service_overview
tools.description: What 4fillment does: warehouses, services, service levels, product rules, and how to get started.

tools.name: get_rate_card
tools.description: The published 3PL rate card with its version: receiving, storage, pick & pack by weight, extras, monthly minimum and add-ons.

tools.name: estimate_monthly_cost
tools.description: Line-by-line monthly fee estimate from order volume, weight, storage and extras, with the monthly minimum applied. Non-standard packaging returns custom_quote_required.

avg_order_weight_lb.description: Average shipped weight per order, in pounds.

pallets_stored.description: Standard pallets (up to 48 in tall) in storage at month end.

tall_pallets_stored.description: Tall pallets (up to 70 in) in storage at month end.

shelves_stored.description: Shelves in storage at month end.

bins_stored.description: Bins in storage at month end (for stock smaller than a pallet).

packaging.description: How orders are packed. kitting, multi_step, fragile_special_handling and other need a custom quote.

inserts_per_order.description: Simple inserts (a flyer or a card) per order.

product_labels_per_month.description: Product labels (e.g. FNSKU) applied per month.

lot_or_expiry_tracked.description: Whether products need lot or expiry tracking.

include_ai_access.description: Include the AI Access add-on (operate the account from an AI assistant). Ignored while the add-on is not offered.

tools.name: check_product_eligibility
tools.description: Says whether products are allowed, need review, or are prohibited at our warehouse. Guidance only; the binding check happens at receiving.

description.description: What the product is, in plain words.

tools.name: ask_4fillment
tools.description: Answers a question about 4fillment from its approved answers, each with its source. Reports when no approved answer exists.

question.description: The question as the user asked it.

tools.name: ask_a_person
tools.description: Opens a support case so a person at 4fillment replies by e-mail. Returns a case reference and an access token. Takes the reply e-mail address, a category, a summary, and optional order, SKU, shipment or tracking numbers.

email.description: The e-mail address for the reply from a person at 4fillment.

category.description: shipping_at_risk or warehouse_stopped for same-day problems; receiving_or_stock, lost_or_damaged or stuck_shipment for stock and shipments; billing, integration, setup or general otherwise.

summary.description: What the user needs, in their words, and what was already tried. No passwords or payment details.

refs.description: Order, SKU, shipment or tracking numbers, if the user has them.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: The status of a 4fillment support case: open, answered or closed, and when a person replies. Needs the case reference and its access token.

token.description: The access token issued with that case reference.
